title: Service Advisor - H. Remove an incomplete (in-progress) inspection
preconds: Logged in as Service Advisor. WO = View/Create&Edit (no WO Delete) but WOL = V/E/D -> full inspection rights follow the LINE (SV-8095). A line has an in-progress / not-started (incomplete) inspection.
steps:
1. Log in.
  2. Open the line with an incomplete inspection.
  3. Look for / click the bin (remove) icon.
  4. Confirm removal if prompted.
expected:
Step 3: A confirmation dialog appears: "Remove inspection - Are you sure you want to remove this inspection?" (Cancel / Remove).
Step 4: On Remove, the incomplete inspection is removed. (Removing an INCOMPLETE inspection is gated by WOL Create and Edit - SV-8095 AC3A, finalized.)
